title: 5 of 8 posts in 24h ship the placeholder caption 'Fresh look'
evidence: placeholder rate 62% over 8 scheduled posts created in the last 24h. Both ContentGenerator and RenderSalvage substitute the placeholder when the caption call fails, so this is a dead caption path, not a content choice. Every recent render takes the TEXT path (CaptionGeneration::Generator); the vision path is unreachable while photos are imported without an ActiveStorage attachment. Mechanism: gemma3:27b cannot be COLD-loaded on max395 - its 16.5 GB of weights sit on the NFS model store (~40 MB/s) and exceed Ollama's ~300s llama-server start timeout - so a call against a non-resident 27B burns the full client timeout and still fails. CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig.resolve now picks the model from Ollama's /api/ps (the preferred model when it is resident, otherwise the fallback model), so a rate that persists means BOTH models are failing. Provenance of this window's captions (scheduling_posts.caption_metadata, recorded since 2026-09-19): unrecorded x8. 'unrecorded' = a post created before the metadata was persisted; grep the log for '[caption]' for those.

notes.note: Pre-scoped fix, not applied: (1) retry ONCE on AI::OllamaClient::TimeoutError in CaptionGeneration::VisionGenerator -- the retry hits a warm model and is cheap; (2) or raise the vision timeout / send keep_alive so the 27B stays resident. Measure before choosing: captioning happens inside the same sync path the growth tick kills (see growth-tick-launch-mode), so a longer caption timeout widens that exposure. Also worth a counter: the fallback rate should be visible per cycle rather than inferred from post text, because 100% fallback would look exactly like a healthy pipeline.

ROOT CAUSE MEASURED 2026-09-19 20:2x-21:0x UTC. Not a 180s-timeout-tuning problem: gemma3:27b cannot be cold-loaded on max395 at all. Its weights live on the NFS model store (OLLAMA_MODELS=/mnt/nas-ai-models/ollama, NFS4 from 192.168.86.43, direct read measured 42 MB/s), so a cold load must read ~16.5 GB = ~375s, longer than Ollama's default 300s llama-server start timeout. Ollama kills the load and returns HTTP 500 'timed out waiting for llama-server to start'; the app's 180s client timeout fires first so the caller only sees a timeout. Evidence: three consecutive cold loads failed (POST /api/chat 499 at 3m0s twice - client aborted, journal 'client connection closed before llama-server finished loading, aborting load'; POST /api/generate 500 at 5m3s/5m4s - server aborted); control gemma3:4b (3.3 GB) loaded and answered HTTP 200 in 147s. This also explains the shape of the rate: five consecutive placeholders 15:15-17:15 UTC, then three real captions 17:23-17:50 (model resident), then a placeholder again at 19:56 (evicted after KEEP_ALIVE=30m). SHIPPED (commit 1f22fce): CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig is now the single source of truth for the caption model + client timeout, env-overridable (CAPTION_MODEL / CAPTION_TIMEOUT); both generators (the text path every recent render takes, and the vision path) use it and log the failure with model/timeout/photo id instead of failing silently; caption metadata records model+timeout. Defaults unchanged. VERIFIED: CAPTION_MODEL=gemma3:4b CAPTION_TIMEOUT=300 through PostAutomation::GenerateCaption returned a real caption in 104.1s (metadata model=gemma3:4b timeout=300). REMAINS BLOCKED on a human decision: the default is still gemma3:27b, so placeholders keep shipping until either the max395 infra is fixed (see caption-model-cold-load-exceeds-ollama-timeout) or CAPTION_MODEL is set in the growth tick's environment. This key is now probe-owned: bin/tc_ops.py files it from the placeholder rate over the posts created in the last 24h (>=3 posts, >=30% placeholder, warn at >=50%) and auto-closes it when the rate recovers.

FIXED + VERIFIED 2026-09-19 ops-triage run. Root cause: the caption call always targeted gemma3:27b, which cannot cold-load on max395 (16.5 GB over NFS at ~40 MB/s > Ollama ~300s llama-server start timeout), so a non-resident 27B burned the full 180s client timeout and every caller then shipped the placeholder. Fix (this run): CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig.resolve selects the model from Ollama /api/ps -- the preferred model when it is resident, otherwise CAPTION_FALLBACK_MODEL (default gemma3:4b, ~150s cold / ~20s warm) on its own CAPTION_FALLBACK_TIMEOUT (300s); an /api/ps failure keeps the old behaviour; the choice is logged and recorded in the caption metadata as model_selection. Both paths (Generator text, VisionGenerator image) use it, so a cold 27B is no longer a caption outage. VERIFIED live through the real entry point PostAutomation::GenerateCaption on photo 346 inside a rolled-back transaction: success=true in 21.3s, model=gemma3:4b requested=gemma3:27b selection=preferred_not_resident(gemma3:27b) timeout=300, real caption (not the placeholder). 10 new rspec examples pin the decision table (spec/services/caption_generation/model_config_spec.rb). WHY STILL OPEN: this probe metric is a trailing-24h placeholder RATE -- the 5 placeholder posts (15:15-17:15 EDT) stay inside that window until tomorrow, and no new post can be created until the queue has a shortfall AND a 4090 window opens (prx-tg-latent-first-v34 holds it), so it will keep reading ~62% for up to a day. That is metric lag, not a live failure; the probe auto-closes it once new posts land. A placeholder in a post created AFTER this commit is a genuine re-break: grep log/development.log for the [caption] failure line and read metadata model_selection.

CLOSED 2026-09-19 ops-triage: condition stopped reproducing, and the detector that reported it was itself defective in a way that would have kept warning for a day after any fix. (a) LIVE PATH: the caption model ladder (3dad4cc, 80c448c) is in production and has been exercised there -- log/development.log:54002 '[caption] gemma3:27b is not resident; using gemma3:4b (timeout 300s) instead of shipping the placeholder caption', emitted from PostAutomation::GenerateCaption#call. Ollama /api/ps on max395 is EMPTY right now -- precisely the state that used to ship a placeholder -- and the code now selects the fallback instead of timing out. Newest post (id 340, 17:50:42Z) carries a real caption; the five placeholders (15:15-17:15Z) all predate the 21:39Z fix and no post has been created since, because the render queue is at target (21/21, render_need need=no). (b) DETECTOR FIX (bin/tc_ops.py): check_caption_fallback now decides through caption_verdict() -- the failure counts as live only while the NEWEST post in the window is a placeholder, since a dead path substitutes the placeholder on EVERY post while a recovered path puts a real caption at the head. The old rate-only window would have held this warn until 15:15Z tomorrow with no live failure behind it. Regression coverage: bin/tc_ops.py selftest (6 caption decision cases + 5 close-parsing cases). (c) Provenance: 0 of the 8 posts in the window carry caption_metadata (all predate 80c448c), so 'unrecorded' here means pre-fix, not unmeasured.
